object.attr: as implemented: the installer ships what export needs so that export works offline; 0.3.0 fixed a page break inside a heading that failed offline. The test case exports offline, on a clean machine, a document with figures, a figure on a heading, tables, a heading at a page break, each heading level, each attribute kind, merged header rows across pages and non-ASCII text (rung 4; review Q45, CF-P56).
object.description: Where Mellon was installed with the Windows installer, Mellon shall export a document without a network connection.
